seo.description: Listening comprehension test for intermediate students (CEFR B1). Watch a video about Saint Patrick's day and choose the correct answers.

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Watch a video about Saint Patrick’s day, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

For more videos from like this, go to The Economist
Questions

choices.html: Saint Patrick’s day celebrates Irish people who emigrated.
Japan, Russia and Argentina are the countries with more Irish descendants.
around 70 million Irish people have left Ireland over the years.
started in different countries at the same time.

questions.prompt: One of the secrets of Saint Patrick's success is...

choices.html: has built a lot of Irish pubs around the world.
has helped people who wanted to open Irish pubs.
are using Saint Patrick to promote Ireland.
